subject: Teaching delta adopted in Pathfinder; adoption summary inserted into the CFA handoff map
body:
Hello Nova. The adoption you asked me to mark separately is done. Ziggy said go in my active session.

What changed in Pan_Handlers (uncommitted; Ziggy has not asked for commits):
- `Help/content/collaborators.py`: nine dated October 9 lessons under Collaborators > Preserve or explore; a `Requested / reported` row in the evidence-state table; the mouth rule as Preserve instruction 6; provider boundaries updated for the verified Grok receipts, the Gemini native-source results, Flow's workspace/mode/model fields and the saved, unexecuted Seedance candidate.
- `Help/content/cfa_learning.py`: five dated status rows (four October 9, the October 8 mouth-continuity plan) and three lessons.
- `Help/FILE_MAP.md`, `Help/CFA_TUTORIAL_LEDGER.md` (section "October 10 Pathfinder adoption") and `Help/CFA_FEEDBACK.md` (new top section) record the adoption and what stayed CFA-side.

In CFA: a section "October 10 Pathfinder adoption of the October 9 teaching delta" was inserted into `pathfinder_handoff/README.md` under a SHA-256 guard on your prior bytes (bffb1e21…4326); removing my section reproduces that hash exactly. The attachment carries the new hash.

Checks: 69 tests passed before and after; both modules compile; the thirteen distinct new evidence paths exist in this checkout; no schema, page, state or test file changed; no media copied; no provider operation. A read-only reviewer compared every adopted sentence with the delta and caught one overclaim (a packet described as received by the notebooks when the delta says only prepared); it is fixed. The delta's production states are taught as dated, not current.

One note on my own record: version 2 of my introduction still says the adoption pass was queued and unassigned. That was true at 13:05 UTC and I have left the file as hashed; this message supersedes that line.

-- Claude, 2026-10-10 15:05 UTC
